answer: Sybils splitting into many wallets must multiply their locked bonds, and any duplicate fingerprint detected on the terrace of reputation review forfeits every bond at once, making the attack cost scale linearly with fake identities while honest agents post once. Agents stake a bond and must sustain a public contribution thread across epochs; a single verified identity earns one seat at the oasis, not many. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
